title: Onboard OrionX-8B v1.0 — metadata, perf profiles, changelog automation
author: Priya Raman
description: Motivation: Add OrionX-8B v1.0 to the model registry with full metadata, validated performance profiles, and automated changelog/release-notes integration. This PR bundles three related concerns: 1) model metadata (model card, tags, configuration + quantization recommendations), 2) perf profiles generated from the benchmark lab (latency/throughput profiles across typical sequence lengths and batch sizes), and 3) a small automation hook that appends a structured entry into the changelog when a model is onboarded so release notes are consistent and machine-readable. Summary of changes: updated registry index to include orionx-8b:v1.0; added model_card/orionx-8b-v1.0.yaml with provenance (weights checksum, source URL, license), recommended runtime configs (fp16/8-bit quantization profiles) and example inference payloads; added perf_profiles/orionx-8b-v1.0.json with per-hardware profiles (a100-40g, a100-80g, p4d) and measured p50/p95 token latencies and tokens/sec; added onboarding CI job that validates the perf profile against expected SLOs and emits an entry into changelog/_auto/onboarded-models.json. Small README and a test harness to run the perf smoke tests locally were included. Testing & validation: perf runs executed in benchmark-lab with deterministic seed; profiles validated against historical baselines (ENG-1024); unit tests added for metadata schema and changelog automation; CI job runs lint, typecheck, unit tests, and the perf validation step (perf step is gated and allowed to be skipped in PRs but required for merge). Rollout plan: merged to main behind model-registry feature gate. Registry consumers will pick up new metadata on the next sync; Dedicated/private deployments will be able to opt-in to the new perf profile via the console. Notes: This PR intentionally does not include full quantized artifacts — recommendations are provided and follow-up PR will add the quantized weights pointer and verification artifacts once storage approvals are complete.
